observations: Black tower-style UPS with a vertical blue panel on the front
"BLUE GATE" embossed at the top front, visible in photo 0 and photo 1
Power button and four LED indicator lights on the blue panel
UK 3-pin power cord plugged into the top of the unit in photo 1
Unit resting on a tiled floor
No model number, VA rating, or serial label visible in either photo
Light dust and scuffing on the casing

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a Blue Gate UPS
photos show visible dust and scuffing; condition cannot be confirmed as like new
exterior photos cannot prove whether the unit was opened or repaired
no power-on or load test shown in the photos
documents are not shown in either photo

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or weak, which is the most common failure in used UPS units
risks.proof: video of the UPS running on battery with a load connected for a measurable time
risks.if_unproven: as not working, requiring battery replacement

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal electronics faults
risks.proof: video showing the unit powering on and displaying normal indicator behavior

risks.risk: Unknown VA/capacity rating, which drives the price of a UPS
risks.proof: clear photo of the rating label on the rear or bottom of the unit
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until the model is identified

risks.risk: Unit may be counterfeit or misbranded
risks.proof: model verification against Blue Gate specifications and a clear label photo
risks.if_unproven: as an unknown or generic UPS

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/rating label showing the VA capacity
Video of the UPS powering on and running on battery with a load
Photos of the original receipt and warranty documents
response.reason: The brand is visible but the model and VA rating that set the price are unreadable, and the seller's working claim is unproven, so no price can be set even at worst case without the label shot and a working demonstration.
